/bin/bash -lc "set +e
printf '%s\\n' '--- python3 compileall ---'
python3 -m compileall -q app tests; echo \"exit="'$?"
printf '"'%s\\n' '--- python3 import worker ---'
python3 -c 'import app.worker; print(\"import ok\")'; echo \"exit="'$?"
printf '"'%s\\n' '--- declared build/test/lint configuration ---'
python3 - <<'PY'
import tomllib
with open('pyproject.toml','rb') as f: d=tomllib.load(f)
print('project.scripts=', d.get('project',{}).get('scripts'))
print('dependencies=', d.get('project',{}).get('dependencies'))
PY
echo \"exit="'$?"
printf '"'%s\\n' '--- git status ---'
git status --short"
